title: Generic clopenness of a section component over a base-point closure
statement: Let $g:P\to T$ be a finite type morphism of schemes (locally of finite type and quasi-compact as in [def-weil-finite-type-morphism]), and let $\sigma:T\to P$ be a section with $g\circ\sigma=\operatorname{id}_T$. For every point $y\in T$ there is an ambient open $V\subseteq T$ containing $y$ such that the subset of $g^{-1}(V\cap\overline{\{y\}})$ consisting of points $q$ in the connected component of $\sigma(g(q))$ in the topological fibre $g^{-1}(\{g(q)\})$ is open and closed in the subspace topology. No noetherian, separatedness, flatness or smoothness hypothesis is imposed.

source.place: Tag 055N, using Tag 055M; ambient-open and closed-immersion topological formulation

proof.text: Apply generic-fibre component spreading to the point sigma(y). The section identity places this point in the fibre over y. Obtain V and A with clopen trace, and identify the generic trace with the connected component. Its preconnectedness and its containment of sigma(y) follow from Mathlib connectedComponentIn lemmas.
Apply persistence of preconnected fibres to A, using the generic trace equality and the rational section point. Obtain an open W containing y inside V on which all fibre traces are preconnected.

Restrict the section to V intersect closure {y} and pull back the open trace of A. Express this open preimage as the trace of an ambient open B of T; sigma(y) in A shows y in B. Set L = W intersect B. This guarantees the section point of every fibre over L intersect closure {y} lies in A. Pull clopenness back along the inclusion of the new total-space subtype.

For a fibre over t in L intersect closure {y}, its intersection with A is preconnected and contains sigma(t), so Mathlib IsPreconnected.subset_connectedComponentIn puts it inside the component. For the converse pull the clopen trace back to the fibre subtype. Mathlib IsPreconnected.subset_isClopen puts the connected component of its section point inside that trace. Use connectedComponentIn_eq_image to pass back to P. These two inclusions identify the required locus with the clopen trace of A.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_open_section_component_clopen {P T : Scheme.{u}} (g : P ⟶ T)
    [LocallyOfFiniteType g] [QuasiCompact g]
    (σ : T ⟶ P) (hσ : σ ≫ g = 𝟙 T) (y : T) :
    ∃ V : Set T, IsOpen V ∧ y ∈ V ∧
      IsClopen {q : g ⁻¹' (V ∩ closure {y}) |
        (q : P) ∈ connectedComponentIn (g ⁻¹' {g (q : P)}) (σ (g (q : P)))}
